name: Soufflé
body:
Station and Complexity patissier 5

Flavor Profiles umami, salty, temperature, temperature, texture
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

Soufflé is a baked dish made primarily with eggs. A wide variety of additional ingredients can be added to make it savory or sweet.

When consumed, you choose to either increase the consumer’s size by 1 category, to a maximum of Huge, or decrease the consumer’s size by 1 category, to a minimum of Tiny, for the duration. This functions as enlarge person or reduce person, respectively, except the target is one living creature, and more than one serving can be consumed to increase or decrease size further, to the listed maximum or minimum.

Every 2 additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1.
